name: Deore brake-lever pair
weight_description: Weight not yet resolved: the 1987 catalogue lists 300 g per BL-MT60 pair, while the 1989 catalogue lists 310 g per pair. Both describe the 22.2 mm clamp assembly without enough information to distinguish the weighed configurations. Neither figure is selected or averaged.
